turns_text: [SEG0001] person_1 (NURSE): Doctor, Mrs. Ananya Kapoor has come. Her husband is waiting outside. Her blood pressure is one hundred and ten over seventy, pulse eighty-eight.
[SEG0002] person_2 (DOCTOR): One second, this screen has hung. What was the pulse, say it again?
[SEG0003] person_1 (NURSE): Eighty-eight, doctor. She is looking quite tense. Call me when you want the husband.
[SEG0004] person_2 (DOCTOR): Yes, alright. Please sit, Mrs Kapoor. What brings you today?
[SEG0005] person_3 (PATIENT): Good morning, doctor. Thank you for seeing me. I am pregnant, around eight to ten weeks I believe, and I have spotting and cramps. I am really very worried.
[SEG0006] person_2 (DOCTOR): Spotting, hmm. Sorry, it wants the password again. Since when is the spotting?

[SEG0007] person_3 (PATIENT): The spotting began three days back. It is light and brownish, and it does not fill a pad. The cramps are mild, in the lower abdomen, they come and go, and they have been there for four days.
[SEG0008] person_2 (DOCTOR): I need the last period for this form. When was it?
[SEG0009] person_3 (PATIENT): I am sorry, doctor, I cannot be exact. The last period was around Diwali, or after. I did not write the date down.
[SEG0010] person_2 (DOCTOR): Around Diwali or after. Was there a pregnancy test?
[SEG0011] person_3 (PATIENT): Yes, doctor. The urine test at home was positive about three weeks ago. I started folic acid after that.
[SEG0012] person_2 (DOCTOR): Folic acid, what dose? I was on the wrong tab, please repeat.
[SEG0013] person_3 (PATIENT): Five milligrams, once daily, by mouth. I have taken it regularly.
[SEG0014] person_2 (DOCTOR): Any other medicine at all?
[SEG0015] person_3 (PATIENT): No, doctor, only the folic acid. My sister takes biotin for her hair fall, but that is hers alone. I have never taken biotin.
[SEG0016] person_2 (DOCTOR): Any allergy to medicines?
[SEG0017] person_3 (PATIENT): No, doctor. I have no known allergies.
[SEG0018] person_2 (DOCTOR): Does the bleeding get heavy, any clots, any pad soaking through?
[SEG0019] person_3 (PATIENT): No, doctor. There are no clots, and I am not soaking a pad.
[SEG0020] person_2 (DOCTOR): Any fever, dizziness, or pain at the tip of the shoulder?
[SEG0021] person_3 (PATIENT): No fever, doctor. No dizziness, and no shoulder pain.
[SEG0022] person_2 (DOCTOR): Nausea or vomiting?
[SEG0023] person_3 (PATIENT): Mm, I suppose, sometimes, not really. The nausea is hard to describe.
[SEG0024] person_2 (DOCTOR): The printer has started, I missed it. Is there vomiting?
[SEG0025] person_3 (PATIENT): No vomiting, doctor. For the nausea, sometimes I feel a little off and sometimes not really. I cannot say for certain.
[SEG0026] person_2 (DOCTOR): We will leave that, then. Kindly lie down, I will examine the abdomen.
[SEG0027] person_2 (DOCTOR): The abdomen is soft. There is mild tenderness suprapubically. There is no guarding.
[SEG0028] person_3 (PATIENT): It is slightly sore when you press, yes. Doctor, may I request that my husband come in? He is waiting and I would like him to hear you.
[SEG0029] person_2 (DOCTOR): Nurse, please bring him. Where has this cursor gone now.
[SEG0030] person_1 (NURSE): He is just outside. I will bring him in.

[SEG0031] person_4 (FAMILY_MEMBER): Sorry, doctor, the corridor was full. She has hardly slept. I should also say, I take metformin for my own sugar, five hundred milligrams twice a day. She does not take it, please.
[SEG0032] person_2 (DOCTOR): That metformin is yours, not hers, understood. Mrs Kapoor, previous pregnancies, or any operation?
[SEG0033] person_3 (PATIENT): No, doctor. This is my first pregnancy. I have not undergone any surgery.
[SEG0034] person_2 (DOCTOR): Any thyroid problem, diabetes, or high blood pressure yourself?
[SEG0035] person_3 (PATIENT): No, doctor. I have none of those.
[SEG0036] person_4 (FAMILY_MEMBER): Her mother had blood pressure trouble in pregnancy, I think. Is that important?
[SEG0037] person_3 (PATIENT): Yes, that is right. My mother had high blood pressure while she was carrying me. She is quite well now.
[SEG0038] person_2 (DOCTOR): My working impression is a threatened miscarriage, because of the spotting and cramps this early, though I cannot confirm that the pregnancy is viable without a scan.
[SEG0039] person_3 (PATIENT): A threatened miscarriage. Please tell me, doctor, is there a chance everything is still alright?

[SEG0040] person_2 (DOCTOR): There is a chance, yes, but I will not promise anything today. We will do an ultrasound scan today, and blood tests, beta hCG, haemoglobin, and blood group. They can be done this morning.
[SEG0041] person_3 (PATIENT): Thank you, doctor. May I continue the folic acid? Kindly tell me what I should do at home.

[SEG0042] person_2 (DOCTOR): Continue the folic acid five milligrams once daily. Take rest, and no heavy lifting. If the bleeding becomes heavy, you pass clots, the pain turns severe, or you feel faint, come back to emergency immediately, do not wait.
[SEG0043] person_1 (NURSE): I will take her for the blood tests and book the scan for this morning. Sir, you can come along with her.
